storyCards.fact:
Chris Cagle's "Chicks Dig It" reached #53 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Chicks Dig It" is a song co-written and recorded by American country music singer Chris Cagle.

The song peaked at #53 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 15 weeks on the chart.

Chicks Dig It was released in 2003.
